query: For a 72-year-old female: among female inpatients 67–77 with ACS and an ICU stay, what are mean risk score and 30‑day mortality? Compare cardiac and neurologic complication rates and survivor mean LOS to age‑matched general inpatients, and report matched-profile percentile.
final_sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(mortality_rate) FROM acs_icu_patients_72_30_mortality) AS avg_mortality_rate, (SELECT AVG(survival_length_of_stay) FROM acs_icu_patients_72_30_survival) AS avg_survival_length_of_stay, (SELECT AVG(cardiac_complications_rate) FROM acs_icu_patients_72_30_complications_rate) AS avg_cardiac_complications_rate, (SELECT AVG(neurologic_complications_rate) FROM acs_icu_patients_72_30_complications_rate) AS avg_neurologic_complications_rate, (SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY survival_rate) FROM acs_icu_patients_72_30_survival_rate) AS survival_percentile_75 FROM acs_icu_patients_72_30;
